description: CAM programming from customer models and drawings; sending programs to the VMC over the shop network and to the turning center by USB stick; setups and machining
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: All receipts come from machined parts (about $3,500 a week); OEM on-time delivery scorecards; a lost day of CAM work is the most the owner can redo; released OEM programs must not change without approval
manual_workaround: Machines keep running programs already in controller memory; repeat jobs continue; new jobs wait; programs re-posted from the CAM files after recovery and checked against the released copy
dependent_third_parties: CAM software vendor (online license check); internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-machinist (single point of failure); the shop bay and power

description: In-process and final inspection; first article inspection reports; certificates of conformance; material certificates and heat-lot traceability; packing and shipping
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: OEMs will not accept parts without records; SQAs require 10-year record retention; a missing record can make a good part unshippable; paper travelers are the source record
manual_workaround: Handwritten inspection records on the paper traveler; certificates typed later; hold shipments that need a first article report until records are rebuilt
dependent_third_parties: OEM supplier portals; outside processors (their certificates); calibration lab; parcel carrier

description: Receiving requests for quote and drawing packages by email and customer portals; quoting; accepting POs; checking drawings for export-control or CUI markings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Requests for quote usually allow 3 to 5 days; lost quotes cost future work but not current receipts; screening every drawing package is how the shop avoids taking in CUI or ITAR data
manual_workaround: Download drawings directly from the customer portals on another device; quote by phone; ask customers to resend

description: Invoices and payments in the accounting SaaS; bank feed; buying bar stock and tooling; POs to outside processors
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers pay on net-30 terms; invoicing is weekly; material can be bought by phone with a card; payment-redirection fraud is the main loss path
manual_workaround: Invoice from a template on paper or the phone; call suppliers to order; verify any bank-detail change by phone to a known number
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS provider; bank; outside bookkeeper; material suppliers

description: Supplier questionnaires and audits; NDAs and SQAs; CMMC Level 1 self-assessment and SPRS affirmation; insurance, licenses, taxes; this GRC set
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in weeks, except the CMMC affirmation that must be current before the December 2026 aerospace award
manual_workaround: Paper copies of key contracts in the office; customer portals hold copies of submitted records
dependent_third_parties: Productivity suite provider; aerospace customer; OEM quality teams
